digest.component_or_area: Bedrock LLM provider integration and parity measurement
propositions: An opt-in operator-run provider-parity harness must measure whether Bedrock can substitute for direct Anthropic as the LLM substrate for the review gate
Payload and tool parity must be proven via captured outbound requests, not code inspection; same system prompts, messages, and tool definitions must reach both providers

Bedrock inference-profile IDs must be invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 before corpus spend, with per-slot temperature probes to confirm capability handling matches the model's supports_temperature override
The harness must run the same 30-item corpus across both providers at N=3 epochs per arm with concurrent execution, holding model class constant and provider as the only variable
Provider routing must be demonstrated provider-clean via REBAR_USAGE_LOG tally showing zero non-Bedrock calls on the Bedrock arm across both class slots
